correctness.rationale: For any feasible cardinality-optimal index set A, the Rogers dual at eta=1/t is |B|+(s-S_B)/t. Subtract N=|A|, write |A|=S_A/t+sum_{i in A}(1-x_i/t), and separate B\A versus A\B: the defect is exactly (s-S_A+sum_{A triangle B}|x_i-t|)/t, both terms nonnegative. Taking expectations uses E S_B=s and E|B|=sum F_i(t). Equality requires and is implied by S_B=s almost surely since every x outside B exceeds t (ties have zero probability). Independence with a nondegenerate bounded truncated variable implies Var(S_B)>0. Independently verified exact rational arithmetic for 12,480 fixed finite configurations; the unrestricted proof is algebraic, not enumeration.
